expect.offline: Each query runs in its own child execution of the same workflow (Execute scraper for query, waitForSubWorkflow false; the bench activates the self-calling workflow and awaits the children, P20). The maps search page is a stand-in for Google's HTML: the scraper only regex-matches http(s)://host strings in it, so the page carries a few Google, gstatic and schema.org URLs (filtered out) and the business sites. The template's Save emails to Google Sheet names no spreadsheet or tab; config/2567.json fills both
